title: NUL byte passes Message-ID validation
description: is_valid_message_id (core/src/validation.rs:56) uses c.is_whitespace() which does not match the NUL byte (\x00). A peer can send Message-ID: <te\x00st@example.com> which passes all validation checks. The NUL is then stored verbatim in the msgid_map SQLite table. Any downstream tool that processes stored Message-IDs (syslog, grep, shell scripts, future C FFI) will interpret NUL as a string terminator and silently truncate or corrupt the value. RFC 5322 §2.2 forbids NUL in header field values. Fix: add inner.chars().any(|c| c == '\0') return false check in is_valid_message_id.
